findings.message: 'Solution' presents the cleanser as solving oiliness outright, while the image line and the product page scope it to 'reduces the oily look'. The headline also names the actives without their 2% (LNG-01), which is the brand's signature.
findings.fix: Spotted: oiliness. Formulated with BHA + LHA 2%
State it as on the pack: 'Niacinamide 10%'.
